text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — we're looking at a narrow repricing window for a subset of Marketplace SKUs tied to incoming HW credits. Need to define a 'paused renewal' safeguard so customers don't get surprise downgrades during private-offer transitions.

Jon: do you mean a grace period before the new list price hits existing private offers? how long are we thinking? :thinking_face:

Aisha: yes. proposal: 30-day grace for active private offers, plus an explicit opt-in email for customers before automatic repricing. also want a wiggle-room cushion so partners can stack a small hardware kicker without breaking revenue math.

Sophie: from HW partner side we can commit to a 5% kicker for select launch customers, but we need a timeline. if you want the kicker applied to private-offer SKUs we need the offer window locked 7 days prior to public announce.

Priya: Finance: 30-day grace OK but need to flag deferred revenue impact. if the kicker reduces net ARR, we need a rev-rec memo. also suggest limiting tiered discounts to avoid overlap with existing enterprise credits.

Marco: Legal: fine with 30-day repricing moratorium as long as the private-offer T&Cs include a one-time repricing clause. draft clause idea: ```"Seller reserves the right to adjust list prices for new subscriptions. Existing private offers shall not be repriced for a period of thirty (30) days following notification. Any hardware or partner credit applied to a private offer requires customer consent and will be documented as an addendum."``` Thoughts?

Jon: LGTM. can we add language for "paused renewals" where customers who have set "auto-renew=off" are explicitly excluded from automatic migration? want to avoid surprises.

Aisha: yes — exclude auto-renew=off. plus require a manual opt-in flow if they want the new discount + kicker. we'll coordinate messaging and timing.

Sophie: we'll hold the partner announcement until we see the locked offer list. target: lock offers by Tue EOD.

marketplace-bot: New private-offer draft created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKT-7412 (assignee: Aisha) :robot_face:

Priya: action items: (1) Finance to model rev-rec scenarios by Mon, (2) Legal to push draft clause into the private-offer template, (3) Partnerships to lock final offer list by Tue, (4) HW PM (Sophie) to confirm kicker eligibility list.

Aisha: perfect — looping in stakeholders now. @Sophie @Priya @Marco i'll ping for a quick 15 min sync tomorrow.

Jon: thanks — will prep comms draft for customers that opt-in to the stacked credit flow.
